title: gRPC request-duration metric must reflect embedded ErrorResult, not just transport err
answers: Why does a request with an embedded Error field show status_code=OK in storage_server_grpc_request_duration_seconds?
VectorSearch/Read response Error isn't reflected in grpc status metric
How to make gRPC metrics show the real error code when the RPC itself returned nil error
body:
Symptom: unified-storage responses that succeed at the transport level but carry a populated ErrorResult (e.g. ReadResponse.Error, VectorSearchResponse.Error) were labeled status_code=OK in gRPC duration metrics.
Root cause: pkg/storage/unified/resource/grpc_interceptor.go:UnaryRequestDurationInterceptor only derived the metric label from status.Code(err), ignoring any Error field embedded in the response message.
Fix pattern: after calling handler, when err == nil, type-assert the response to an interface exposing GetError() *resourcepb.ErrorResult and compute the metric code via grpcCodeFromErrorResult(result.GetError()) instead of defaulting to OK.
Constraints: only applies to response messages that have a protobuf-generated GetError() accessor for an embedded ErrorResult field; a transport-level grpc error (non-nil err) still takes precedence over any embedded Error.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource gRPC interceptors and any resourcepb response type with an embedded ErrorResult field

search: gRPC request-duration metric status_code labels must capture embedded ErrorResult fields in response messages, not only transport-level gRPC errors, to correctly reflect actual failure even when the gRPC call succeeds at the protocol level. After the handler returns with err == nil, type-assert the response to an interface exposing GetError() *resourcepb.ErrorResult, then set the metric status_code via grpcCodeFromErrorResult() instead of defaulting to OK. Transport-level errors (non-nil err) still take precedence over embedded errors. Applies to gRPC interceptors like UnaryRequestDurationInterceptor in pkg/storage/unified/resource/grpc_interceptor.go and any resourcepb response type with an embedded ErrorResult field. See pkg/storage/unified/resource/errors.go:grpcCodeFromErrorResult for implementation.
